Name: help
Description: Displays a list of available commands and their descriptions

Name: logout
Description: Logs out of the current session

Name: print
Description: Outputs the provided text to the terminal

Name: user
Argument Descriptions: -none: No extension displays the user menu (optional), *add: Adds a new user (required), *list: Lists all users (required), *modify: Modifies a user (required), *remove: Deletes a user (required)

Name: debug
Description: Enables debugging mode for the terminal

Name: ccommand
Description: Allows the creaton of new commands
